about: Art direction spec for the Magic Card icon library and the preset look. Written for direction B (Living rigs); see assets/brand/art-direction/directions-board.png. Piece indices come from splitIcon on @mdi/js 7.4.47 (drawing order). Part ids, piece indices, groups and domain match src/icon-anim/library/*.ts.

drawing.grid: viewBox 0 0 24 24, live area 2..22, filled paths only (no strokes), MDI weight: smallest feature 1 unit, outer corner radius 1, inner 0.5

sources.mdi: stock MDI path, auto-split by subpath; parts list piece indices
sources.mdi+shapes: stock MDI path plus RigShape overlays (accent fill) for lights and baubles only
sources.rig: own paths from assets/brand/icon-library/<file>: one <path> element per piece, in file order; a <g> marks a group, data-pivot gives the pivot

own_paths: at least two path elements (one element is auto-split by subpath and loses the intended pieces)
holes by opposite winding (nonzero); own paths carry no evenodd flag
a moving part overlaps its still neighbour by at least 1 unit at the joint, or the still part carries a joint disc (r 1.5..2.5) drawn first; no hairline seams at any pose
parts that separate during the motion keep a 1 unit gap at rest
coordinates at most 2 decimals; keep the MDI attribution comment when cut from MDI
drawing.accent: at most one accent RigShape per icon, only for light or energy (spark, bauble, beam); fill is a theme glow colour; the icon must read without it

naming.entry_id: kebab-case, the thing first (wind-turbine, heart-broken); never reuse an existing id
naming.entry_name: sentence case, what you see (Wind turbine, Broken heart); theme goes in tags, not the name
naming.part_id: snake_case by role: body, frame, base, mount for still parts; head, lid, flag, rotor, wing_l for movers; sides _l _r _t _b; series bulb_1..n left to right, top to bottom
naming.group_id: the assembly that moves together (rotor, toolhead, cut)

pivots: use anchor keywords (bottom, center, top-left) when the joint sits on the part's box edge
numeric pivots on the real joint, rounded to 0.5: hinge line for lids and doors, axle centre for rotors and dials, hook point for hanging things, base centre for flames and plants, shoulder for wings
a pivot outside its part's box by more than 1.5 units needs a reason in a code comment (the audit flags it)

global.loop: 0% equals 100% for every track; no visible seam
global.amplitude: translate up to 2 units, rotate up to 20 deg (spins excepted), scale 0.85..1.15
global.easing: default cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); settle with cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); linear only for spins and machine travel
global.structure: one hero motion plus at most one secondary; secondary parts lag 8..12% of the cycle
global.event_icons: mailbox, toaster, bells, parcel: action in the first 60%, rest pose for the remaining 40% so a dashboard full of icons stays calm
global.flashes: never more than 3 per second; blinks use opacity 0.35..1, not on/off
global.reduced_motion: hold the 0% rest pose; nothing moves; colour still carries state

fire.feel: irregular flicker: unequal key spacing (0/23/41/67/88), scale_y 0.9..1.1, skew_x up to 5, pivot at the flame base; flames never rotate more than 6 deg

cleaning.feel: purposeful back and forth, glide rather than bounce; sparkles twinkle staggered by a third

christmas.feel: gentle sway and twinkle, ease-in-out, staggered lights

halloween.feel: slow float broken by one quick move (jaw chatter, bat flap 0.5 s)

valentine.feel: lub-dub beat (keys 0, 14, 28, 42 then rest), soft overshoot

home.feel: mechanical: linear spins and travel; events use anticipation and overshoot

light.feel: slow breathing glow, opacity 0.6..1, rays stagger outward; no hard flashes

animals.feel: organic follow-through; nothing loops faster than 0.5 s

motion.contrast: icon colours reach at least 3:1 on #1c1c1c and #ffffff (WCAG 1.4.11 graphics); glow colours are decorative only and never carry meaning or text

presets_look.background: solid tint of the theme icon colour at 8..14% over the card background; optional radial glow behind the icon in the glow colour at up to 25%; no stock gradients
presets_look.glow_border: card glow in the glow colour at up to 35% opacity; border 1..2 px in the icon colour
presets_look.particles: tints from the theme pair; shapes that match the theme (embers, bubbles, snow, bats, hearts)
presets_look.tile: preset name in the HA primary text colour (never coloured text), so names keep AA; still frame for tap-only and heavy scenes is the rest pose with the glow at its peak

audit.tool: tests/icon-library-split-audit.test.ts (opt-in: MC_ICON_AUDIT=1) writes assets/brand/icon-audit/triage-latest.txt and library-parts-sheet.svg

flags.BIG-MOVER: a moving part covers over 50% of the icon next to a still part: the cctv pattern (a mount fused into the mover)
flags.SOLO: the whole icon is one piece: fine for whole-body motion, a cut candidate when only a limb should move
flags.UNASSIGNED: pieces in no part (they never animate)
flags.PIVOT-OUTSIDE: pivot more than 1.5 units outside its part

steps: check every flag on the parts sheet (grey still, colours moving, dot pivot): look for a still piece that belongs to a mover and for a mover that carries something fixed
classify each: fix-cut (own paths), relabel (wrong piece mapping), or accept (motion intended)
re-run after fixes; also run it on new entries before they ship

seed.cctv: fix-cut: done in cctv-rig.svg; piece 0 was the front hood labelled Mount and piece 1 fused the camera with the arm and wall bracket; new pivot [16, 13]
seed.thunderstorm: accept: cloud rumble x 0.3 while the bolt flashes
seed.doorbell-ring, notification: accept: clapper pivot sits at the bell mouth by design
seed.plant, fireplace, thermometer: accept: large movers are the intended subject
seed.clock: later: hour and minute hands are one piece
seed.trash, car, dog, bird, fish, bee: accept now (whole-body motion); cut candidates in later

styles.about: One rig, three looks, chosen per icon on the card (style: quiet | living | glow, default living). Quiet and Glow are derived at load time from the Living document; nothing is authored twice. Board: assets/brand/art-direction/styles-board.png.

quiet.intent: direction A: one colour, one hero, one axis, tiny amplitude; the rig cut still matters (the cctv mount never moves)
steps: 1 measure: for every track, per transform channel, the peak displacement in icon units over all keys: x, y = |v| (x and y together are one translate axis, measured as the vector length); rotate = |deg| * pi/180 * R; scale = |v-1| * R; scale_x = |v-1| * Rx; scale_y = |v-1| * Ry; skew_x = |tan(deg)| * Ry; skew_y = |tan(deg)| * Rx; a motion path counts as translate with its bbox half-diagonal. R, Rx, Ry: farthest distance from the target's pivot to its box corners (overall, horizontal, vertical). Box = union of the target's piece boxes.
2 classify: spin = a rotate track that covers whole turns (span a multiple of 360, linear); flip = a scale channel that crosses 0 (ceiling-fan blades, light-switch toggle, robot-mower turnaround)

3 pick the hero: quiet.hero override if the entry has one; else any spin; else the target with the largest peak (a group beats its own members; within 10% the larger box wins). Flip channels rank last: they only lead when nothing else moves.

4 siblings: tracks whose target id has the same stem as the hero (id minus a trailing _l _r _t _b _m _i _o _tl _tr _bl _br _fl _fr _ol _or _il _ir or digits) and the same dominant channel move too; each keeps its own keys and phase (mirrored wings, chase lights) and takes the hero's factor

5 one axis: keep only the hero's dominant channel (largest peak); every other transform channel on the hero and siblings is dropped. Spin keeps rotate. A flip becomes a squash on the same axis to 1 - 0.3/R (never through 0).

6 scale: factor f = min(1, 0.3 / peak) applied around the rest value (v' = rest + (v - rest) * f), same f for siblings and quiet.with targets. Result peak lands in 0.15..0.3 units; a B peak already under 0.15 stays as it is. Spins are not scaled; their duration doubles.
7 everything else holds its drawn pose (identity transform, not the 0% key), so emitters (drops, steam, slats) sit where the source draws them

8 opacity stays as timing, compressed: o' = 0.7 + 0.3 * o on every track (blinks, chases, emitters, the hero); no part ever goes below 0.7, which also keeps every Quiet icon under the 3 flashes per second rule

9 drop: colour and background tracks (the entity colour rules), draw tracks (hold draw 1), RigShapes whose fill is a glow colour or an accent role (baubles, sparks, glow-only shapes); keep structural shapes (spider thread) and give them quiet.with if they follow the hero

10 timing: keep every key's at and easing so rests and event rhythm survive; overshoot easings (cubic-bezier with y outside 0..1) become cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); duration = max(B duration, 1.6 s), spins B duration x 2; follow_rotation on paths is turned off
quiet.fields: entry.quiet = { hero?: target, with?: [targets scaled by the hero's factor] }; only set where the steps pick wrong
quiet.reduced_motion: same as Living: hold the rest pose

glow.intent: direction C: the Living rig, unchanged motion, plus a lit accent layer in a second colour
glow.accent: entry.accent lists part ids (and shape:<id> for RigShapes) that carry light, fire, heat, energy, signal or magic: flames, bulbs, rays, beams, sparks, sparkles, baubles, bolts, heat and signal waves, glowing eyes, LEDs. Never water, smoke, steam, air, or a part that is the whole icon unless the icon is itself a light source (twinkle-star, sparkle-clean). Empty list = bloom only.
glow.glow_shapes: entry.glow_shapes are RigShapes rendered only in Glow (jack-o-lantern face light, under the pumpkin so it shows through the face holes); Living and Quiet ignore them
render: accent parts and shapes: fill = accent colour (below); non-accent parts keep the icon colour; all Living tracks apply unchanged (halos sit inside the part's own group, so they inherit transform and opacity with no extra animation)

halo (dark cards only): per accent piece, two copies of its path drawn before the fill: stroke accent colour, stroke-linejoin round, width 2.4 at opacity 0.15 and width 1.2 at opacity 0.3, fill none; above 8 accent pieces only the 1.2 ring is drawn; under-layer shapes get no halo

bloom: one circle under the icon at the centre of the accent union box (icon centre when accent is empty), r = min(11, max(w, h)/2 + 4), radialGradient accent colour opacity 0.25 (light cards 0.12) to 0; static

state: the layer is lit only when the entity is active (on, open, heat/cool, playing, home, any non-zero numeric for sensors); inactive or unavailable renders exactly as Living with no halo and no bloom, so colour still carries state and glow carries no meaning

colour.order: 1 the user's glow colour (design option) > 2 entity colour when the entity reports one (light rgb_color / hs_color while on): accent = entity mixed 60% with white 40% on dark cards, mixed 70% with black 30% on light cards; the body keeps the entity colour > 3 theme pair glow (entry cat, or existing[id].glow_theme) > 4 derived: icon colour mixed 45% with white 55% on dark, icon colour mixed 65% with black on light
colour.visibility: after resolving, if the accent is under 2:1 against the card background, step 10% further toward white (dark) or black (light) until it is; compute once per colour change in JS and cache, no CSS color-mix needed
colour.dark_or_light: light card when the resolved card background (--ha-card-background, then --card-background-color) has relative luminance above 0.4; fall back to hass.themes.darkMode
colour.theme_on_light_note: each reaches 3:1 on #ffffff; on dark cards the glow colours from motion.themes reach 7.5..15:1 on #1c1c1c. Both stay decorative (WCAG 1.4.11 does not apply to them)
colour.light_card_fallback: accent fill = theme_on_light (or the mixed colour), no halo rings, bloom at 0.12; motion unchanged

cost.card_default: no SVG or CSS filters at all on the card (no feGaussianBlur, no drop-shadow, no blur keyframes); halos are strokes, the bloom is a gradient
cost.budget_per_icon: at most 16 extra elements (halo copies + bloom), 1 gradient, 0 filters, 0 extra animated properties
cost.optional_soft: a card option glow_quality: soft may add one feGaussianBlur (stdDeviation 0.8 units, filter region 140%) on a static halo group per icon; never on an element with a transform or opacity track; not available on tablets by default and never the default
cost.studio_and_export: the studio preview and the animated SVG export may use the soft filter
cost.offscreen: Glow icons pause with the shared offscreen observer like Living ones
cost.acceptance: target: a dashboard with 20 Glow icons on an older Android tablet running Fully Kiosk stays within 10% CPU of the same dashboard in Living

glow.reduced_motion: rest pose with the accent lit and halos at full strength; nothing moves

styles.living: the document as built from this spec; the default
styles.existing_note: accent and glow colour source for the 107 entries already in src/icon-anim/library.ts (part ids as in that file); no glow_theme = the derived glow (step 4) unless the entity has a colour. No Quiet overrides needed: the steps pick a sensible hero for all 107.
